arXiv:2608.18988v1 [cs.CL] 2026 年 8 月 19 日arXiv:2608.18988v1 [cs.CL] 19 Aug 2026

DeepWeaver：弥合证据合成差距DeepWeaver: Bridging the Evidence Synthesis Gap
在开放式问答中in Open-Ended Question Answering

Xujia WangYizhe Zhang    Bin XuLei HouJuanzi Li[0.6em] Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University[0.3em] klozewang19@gmail.com
摘要Abstract

“检索然后生成”流程通常用于为开放式问题生成深入研究的答案，但仅靠检索是不够的：法学硕士必须将嘈杂且零散的证据组织成全面的、被广泛引用的答案。我们将此过程称为Retrieve-then-generate pipelines are commonly used to produce deep-research answers for open-ended questions, but retrieval alone is insufficient: LLMs must organize noisy and fragmented evidence into comprehensive, well-cited answers. We refer to this process as证据综合evidence synthesis。然而，直接生成常常未充分利用证据，引用不一致，并将不同的信息折叠成肤浅的摘要，从而暴露了检索和生成之间的证据合成差距。因此，我们建议. However, direct generation often underuses evidence, misaligns citations, and collapses diverse information into shallow summaries, exposing an evidence synthesis gap between retrieval and generation. Thus, we propose深韦弗DeepWeaver，一种新颖的框架，通过维护思想区块链（TBC）将嘈杂的检索证据编织成综合答案，思想区块链是一种将主张、显着信息、关键字和支持证据分组的结构化表示。 DeepWeaver 使用从属 TBC 来检查剩余证据、进行 TBC 修订并在最终生成之前发现新的主张。我们通过知识库和网络进行开放式 QA 评估 DeepWeaver，并介绍, a novel framework that weaves noisy retrieved evidence into comprehensive answers by maintaining Thought Block Chains (TBCs), a structured representation that groups claims, salient information, keywords, and supporting evidence. DeepWeaver uses subordinate TBCs to inspect residual evidence, commit TBC revisions, and discover new claims before final generation. We evaluate DeepWeaver on open-ended QA over both knowledge bases and the web, and introduce质量保证LoQA，证据合成的高密度基准。在法学硕士中，DeepWeaver 提高了 LoQA 上的内容充分性、引文基础和细节保留，同时在 DeepResearch Bench 上获得了更深入的见解和更高的引文质量。这些结果表明，证据编织对于连接开放式问答中的检索和生成是有效的。我们的代码位于, a high-density benchmark for evidence synthesis. Across LLMs, DeepWeaver improves content sufficiency, citation grounding, and detail preservation on LoQA, while achieving deeper insights and higher citation quality on DeepResearch Bench. These results show that evidence weaving is effective for bridging retrieval and generation in open-ended QA. Our code is available atthis URL.

1 简介Introduction

22脚注文本：footnotetext:通讯作者.Corresponding author.

大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地被用来生成基于外部证据的研究式答案Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to generate research-style answers grounded in external evidence28; 2。对于特定领域的开放式问题和深入研究型任务，回答查询可能需要整合来自数百个检索到的段落、网页、书籍或技术文档的证据。因此，证据检索和合成是检索增强生成 (RAG) 管道的核心. For domain-specific open-ended questions and deep-research-style tasks, answering a query may require integrating evidence from hundreds of retrieved passages, web pages, books, or technical documents. As a result, evidence retrieval and synthesis are central to both retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines(22; 18)和基于网络的深度研究代理and web-based deep-research agents(30; 53)。这些系统共享一个共同的工作流程：检索证据，将其放入上下文中，并提示模型综合一个全面的答案. These systems share a common workflow: retrieve evidence, place it into the context, and prompt the model to synthesize a comprehensive answer17.

尽管先前的工作已经广泛研究了如何提高证据检索质量Although prior work has extensively studied how to improve evidence retrieval quality(12; 10; 37)，检索本身只是第一步：, retrieval itself is merely the first step:使法学硕士能够有效地使用enabling LLMs to effectively use广泛、嘈杂、碎片化extensive, noisy, and fragmented提供全面答案的证据仍然是一个关键挑战evidence to generate comprehensive answers remains a key challenge。为了更好地整合上游证据、上下文细化方法. To better integrate upstream evidence, context-refinement methods(48; 21)在生成之前压缩、过滤或重组段落，而分而治之的方法compress, filter, or restructure passages before generation, while divide-and-conquer methods(57; 60)将长上下文分割成片段并聚合中间输出。端到端深度研究系统split long contexts into segments and aggregate intermediate outputs. End-to-end deep-research systems(44; 38; 24)通过代理记忆和大纲引导生成，自动进行证据组织和长篇答案写作，从而更进一步。go further by automating evidence organization and long-form answer writing with agent memory and outline-guided generation.

然而，先前的方法高估了法学硕士充分利用输入证据来得出深入、多样化主张的能力。主要通过优化证据呈现和大纲引导的写作However, prior methods overestimate LLMs’ ability to fully exploit input evidence to derive in-depth, diverse claims. By primarily optimizing evidence presentation and outline-guided writing(49)，这些方法往往无法将检索到的证据深度综合为成熟的答案。当面对嘈杂、零碎和知识密集的证据时，仅仅依靠法学硕士的内部推理往往会掩盖细粒度的细节并产生不完善的主张。我们将原始检索证据与综合生成之间的这种脱节定义为, these approaches often fall short in deeply synthesizing retrieved evidence into well-developed answers. When faced with noisy, fragmented, and knowledge-dense evidence, relying solely on the LLM’s internal reasoning often obscures fine-grained details and produces underdeveloped claims. This disconnect between raw retrieved evidence and comprehensive generation is what we define as证据综合差距the evidence synthesis gap.

我们认为We argue that用于编排证据和编织基于证据的主张的中间模块an intermediate module for orchestrating evidence and weaving evidence-grounded claims对于弥合检索和最终答案生成之间的差距至关重要（图is essential for bridging the gap between retrieval and final answer generation (Figure1）。其中心思想是将嘈杂的检索证据构建为细粒度的思维单元，而不是一次性合成答案。). The central idea is to structure noisy retrieved evidence into fine-grained thought units, rather than synthesizing answers in a single pass.

为此，我们建议To this end, we propose深韦弗DeepWeaver，一种基于嘈杂证据的开放式答案生成的新颖框架。 DeepWeaver 维护着, a novel framework for open-ended answer generation grounded in noisy evidence. DeepWeaver maintains aT以为houghtB锁lockChain (TBC) 结构，其中每个思维块对应于答案的一个已发现的方面，并存储其主张、关键字、显着信息和支持证据片段。 DeepWeaver 通过识别当前 TBC 中被忽视的证据并生成从属 TBC 来检查尚未充分覆盖的剩余证据来编织 TBC。新发现的信息和声明随后会提交回主 TBC。这种设计产生证据编织的主张，并将这些主张与相关片段联系起来，从而提高答案的全面性和引用质量，同时减轻上下文窗口压力。hain (TBC) structure, where each thought block corresponds to a discovered aspect of the answer and stores its claim, keywords, salient information, and supporting evidence fragments. DeepWeaver weaves TBCs by identifying overlooked evidence in the current TBC and generating subordinate TBCs to inspect residual evidence that has not been sufficiently covered. Newly discovered information and claims are then committed back into the main TBC. This design produces evidence-woven claims and links these claims to relevant fragments, thereby improving answer comprehensiveness and citation quality while alleviating context-window pressure.

我们对 DeepWeaver 进行了评估We evaluate DeepWeaver on our质量保证LoQA基准（§benchmark (§2.2），一个开放式答案生成基准，具有大量嘈杂的证据。 LoQA 包含 100 个水环境研究问题，每个问题都配有从包含 500 本书和超过 1 亿字符的中国专家知识库中检索的证据。它对 QA 系统是否可以全面使用证据、保留特定领域的细节并生成被广泛引用的答案进行压力测试。我们还使用基于网络的深度研究问题来评估 DeepWeaver), an open-ended answer generation benchmark with extensive noisy evidence. LoQA contains 100 water-environment research questions, each paired with evidence retrieved from a Chinese expert knowledge base comprising 500 books and over 100M characters. It stress-tests whether QA systems can comprehensively use evidence, preserve domain-specific details, and generate well-cited answers. We also evaluate DeepWeaver on web-based deep-research questions using深度研究台DeepResearch Bench 7，其中包含跨不同领域的博士级研究任务。实验表明，DeepWeaver 显着提高了 LoQA 上的内容充分性、引文基础和细节保留，同时比 DeepResearch Bench 上的高级代理获得了更深入的见解和更高的引文质量。, which contains PhD-level research tasks across diverse fields. Experiments show that DeepWeaver substantially improves content sufficiency, citation grounding, and detail preservation on LoQA, while achieving deeper insights and higher citation quality than advanced agents on DeepResearch Bench.

我们的主要贡献包括：Our main contributions include:

  • •

    我们确定了开放式问答中的证据合成差距，强调了在检索之外需要一个明确的合成阶段。We identify the evidence synthesis gap in open-ended QA, highlighting the need for an explicit synthesis stage beyond retrieval.

  • •

    我们提出了 DeepWeaver，一个框架，它将嘈杂的检索证据编排到结构化的思想区块链中，并通过证据编织生成开放式答案。We propose DeepWeaver, a framework that orchestrates noisy retrieved evidence into structured Thought Block Chains and generates open-ended answers via evidence weaving.

  • •

    我们引入了 LoQA，这是评估基于证据的答案生成的基准。实验表明，DeepWeaver 提高了 LoQA 和 DeepResearch Bench 上答案的全面性和引用质量。We introduce LoQA, a benchmark for evaluating evidence-grounded answer generation. Experiments show that DeepWeaver improves answer comprehensiveness and citation quality on both LoQA and DeepResearch Bench.

2 任务制定Task Formulation

我们评估 QA 系统是否可以将大量证据片段合成为全面的开放式答案。此设置反映了现实的信息寻求需求：回答查询可能涉及多个主张，而支持证据分散在各个来源（We evaluate whether a QA system can synthesize a large set of evidence fragments into comprehensive open-ended answers. This setting reflects realistic information-seeking needs: answering a query may involve multiple claims, while the supporting evidence is scattered across sources (例如e.g.、书籍、技术文档和段落）。尽管 RAG 技术可以检索此类证据，但 QA 系统是否可以充分利用它尚不清楚。, books, technical documents, and passages). Although RAG techniques can retrieve such evidence, whether QA systems can fully exploit it is unclear.

2.1 定义Definition

给出一个开放式研究式问题Given an open-ended research-style questionqq和检索到的证据池and a retrieved evidence poolE={e1,e2,…,eN}E=\{e_{1},e_{2},\ldots,e_{N}\}从相关文档收集，需要 QA 系统来生成答案collected from relevant documents, a QA system is required to generate an answeryy从而彻底解决that thoroughly resolvesqq同时以证据为基础。根据表征证据合成质量的三个方面来评估答案：while being grounded in the evidence. Answers are evaluated according to three aspects that characterize evidence synthesis quality:

  • •

    内容充足Content sufficiency：答案应涵盖问题所暗示的主要内容和主张并综合证据。: the answer should cover the major content and claims implied by the question and synthesized from the evidence.

  • •

    细节保留Detail preservation：答案应该保留细粒度的信息，而不是将其折叠成通用摘要。: the answer should retain fine-grained information rather than collapse it into generic summaries.

  • •

    引文接地Citation grounding：答案应以相关证据为依据。: the answer should ground its claims in relevant evidence.

2.2 LoQA 基准The LoQA Benchmark

LoQA是基于包含500本书籍和超过1亿字符的中国水环境领域知识库构建的。我们选择这个领域是因为它包含密集的技术知识、复杂的因果关系和实用的开放式问题，涉及多个子主题的证据，例如污染控制、水质评估和流域管理。LoQA is built from a Chinese water-environment domain knowledge base containing 500 books and over 100M characters. We choose this domain because it contains dense technical knowledge, complex causal relations, and practical open-ended questions, which involve evidence across multiple subtopics, such as pollution control, water quality assessment, and watershed management.

施工。Construction.

LoQA 包含 100 个开放式研究式问题。我们使用多个基于书籍上下文的最先进的 LLM 生成 3,000 个候选问题，然后使用基于 LLM 的分数对它们进行过滤，以实现检索全面性、具体性、领域深度和表达完整性。我们检索每个候选人的证据，并选择与检索到的片段平均相似度最高的最终问题，确保每个问题都包含丰富的证据（§LoQA contains 100 open-ended research-style questions. We generate 3,000 candidate questions using multiple state-of-the-art LLMs based on book contexts, and then filter them using LLM-based scores for retrieval comprehensiveness, concreteness, domain depth, and expression completeness. We retrieve evidence for each candidate and select the final questions with the highest average similarity to the retrieved fragments, ensuring that each question involves rich evidence (§A.1.2).

每个问题都会检索大约 100 个证据片段（分为 1,024 个标记片段）。为了模拟嘈杂的环境，我们添加了另外 100 个随机证据片段About 100 evidence fragments (chunked into 1,024-token segments) are retrieved for each question. 3 方法Method

3.1 区块链思想Thought Block Chain

我们定义We define theT以为houghtB锁lockChain（TBC）作为一种显式数据结构，可以连接检索到的证据和最终答案的生成。 TBC作为DeepWeaver维护的核心信息结构，将答案分解为一系列思维块：hain (TBC) as an explicit data structure that bridges retrieved evidence and final answer generation. The TBC serves as the core information structure maintained by DeepWeaver, decomposing the answer into a sequence of thought blocks:

𝒯=[b1,b2,…,bK].\mathcal{T}=[b_{1},b_{2},\ldots,b_{K}].

每个区块Each blockbib_{i}封装候选主张并存储相应的关键字、显着信息和支持证据片段：encapsulates a candidate claim and stores the corresponding keywords, salient information, and supporting evidence fragments:

bi=(ci,ki,si,Ei),b_{i}=(c_{i},k_{i},s_{i},E_{i}),

哪里whereci,kic_{i},k_{i}和andsis_{i}分别表示权利要求、关键词和显着信息，并且denote the claim, keywords, and salient information, respectively, andEi⊆EE_{i}\subseteq E是与主张相关的证据片段的子集。is the subset of evidence fragments linked to the claim.

与倾向于提供调查而不是解决问题的答案的简单大纲不同，TBC 将详细的证据组织成细粒度的编织声明，同时保持声明和相关证据之间的明确映射，并减少生成过程中的上下文负担。Unlike a plain outline that tends to provide a survey rather than a question-resolving answer, the TBC organizes detailed evidence into fine-grained woven claims, while maintaining an explicit mapping between claims and relevant evidence and reducing the context burden during generation.

3.2 证据编织Evidence Weaving

这种分块生成策略有两个优点：（1）它将上下文压力分解为声明级别的生成，（2）它改善了引文基础，因为每个部分都是从更小且更相关的证据子集生成的。This block-wise generation strategy has two advantages: (1) it decomposes context pressure into claim-level generation, and (2) it improves citation grounding because each section is generated from a smaller and more relevant evidence subset.

4 实验Experiments

我们在知识库开放式问答和端到端基于网络的开放式深度研究方面对 DeepWeaver 进行了评估。We evaluate DeepWeaver on both knowledge-base open-ended question answering and end-to-end web-based open-ended deep research.

4.1 数据集Datasets

LoQA。LoQA.

高密度循证 QA 基准（§A high-density evidence-based QA benchmark (§2.2）包含 100 个研究型实用水环境问题。每个问题都与从 500 本书的知识库中检索到的长上下文证据配对，评估系统是否可以深度综合碎片化的检索证据以生成全面的答案。) with 100 research-style practical water-environment questions. Each question is paired with long-context evidence retrieved from a 500-book knowledge base, evaluating whether systems can deeply synthesize fragmented retrieved evidence to generate comprehensive answers.

深度研究台。DeepResearch Bench.

它包含 22 个领域的 100 项博士级深度研究任务，评估代理在这些任务中搜索网络信息并编写长篇答案。的It contains 100 PhD-level deep-research tasks across 22 fields, where evaluated agents search for web information and write long-form answers. The种族RACE使用法学硕士评审标准分开衡量答案质量，包括全面性、洞察力、遵循指令和可读性split measures answer quality using LLM-judged criteria, including comprehensiveness, insight, instruction following, and readability44 4这里，“全面性”和“洞察力”也对应于我们定义下的证据合成质量的两个方面（§Here, “comprehensiveness” and “insight” also correspond to two aspects of evidence synthesis quality under our definition (§2.1).，同时, while事实FACT衡量引用准确性和有效引用的数量。measures citation accuracy and the number of effective citations.

在推理和分而治之的基线中，SoT 努力保留细粒度的细节并在沉重的上下文负担下识别相关证据。 PaS 的效率较低，因为开源模型通常很难为复杂、证据丰富的问题​​制定可靠的写作计划。 CoA 和 LongRefiner 通过减少上下文负担或完善证据来改善某些情况下的引文使用，但它们仍然存在声明不足和细节缺失的问题。这些结果支持我们的主要主张：Among the reasoning and divide-and-conquer baselines, SoT struggles to preserve fine-grained details and identify relevant evidence under heavy context burden. PaS is less effective because open-source models often struggle to produce reliable writing plans for complex, evidence-heavy questions. CoA and LongRefiner improve citation usage in some cases by reducing context burden or refining evidence, but they still suffer from insufficient claims and missing details. These results support our main claim:全面的答案生成不仅需要检索或过滤证据，还需要有效的证据合成过程comprehensive answer generation requires not only retrieving or filtering evidence, but also an effective evidence synthesis process将细粒度的证据编织成连贯的主张级别结构。that weaves fine-grained evidence into coherent claim-level structures.

这些结果表明These results indicate that theDeepWeaver 的好处不依赖于特定的骨干模型benefit of DeepWeaver does not depend on a specific backbone model。相反，证据编织提供了一种改进噪声证据使用的通用机制。值得注意的是，尽管 DeepSeek-V3.2 是强大的长上下文模型，但使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 的 DeepWeaver 的性能优于使用 DeepSeek-V3.2 的直接生成。这表明，明确地编织证据比仅仅依靠更强的长上下文能力更有效。. Instead, evidence weaving provides a general mechanism for improving the use of noisy evidence. Notably, DeepWeaver with Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 outperforms direct generation with DeepSeek-V3.2, even though DeepSeek-V3.2 is a strong long-context model. This shows that explicitly weaving evidence is more effective than relying solely on stronger long-context capabilities.

4.7 基于网络的深度研究的延伸Extension to Web-Based Deep Research

基于网络的深度研究代理也遵循检索然后生成的范式：搜索网络，收集证据，并从开放域来源合成长格式答案。我们研究 DeepWeaver 是否可以作为证据编织模块来提高深度研究答案的质量。Web-based deep-research agents also follow a retrieve-then-generate paradigm: search the web, collect evidence, and synthesize long-form answers from open-domain sources. We study whether DeepWeaver can serve as an evidence-weaving module to improve deep-research answer quality.

由于检索不是 DeepWeaver 的重点，因此我们重用 WebWeaver 规划器收集的网页和顶级部分标题，以实现简单性和公平比较Since retrieval is not the focus of DeepWeaver, we reuse the web pages and top-level section titles collected by WebWeaver’s planner for simplicity and fair comparison66 6在成本方面，DeepWeaver在取证过程中避免使用摘要模型提取网页级证据，大幅降低了规划阶段的成本瓶颈。参见§In terms of cost, DeepWeaver avoids using a summary model to extract webpage-level evidence during evidence collection, substantially reducing the planning-stage cost bottleneck. See §A.3用于成本比较。for the cost comparison.。每个问题都分解为章节级别的写作任务。对于每个部分，DeepWeaver 将收集到的网页视为证据片段，并生成相应的顶级答案部分（§. Each question is decomposed into section-level writing tasks. For each section, DeepWeaver treats the collected web pages as evidence fragments and generates the corresponding top-level answer section (§A.2).

与 WebWeaver 在网页级别将证据总结为粗粒度的大纲标题不同，DeepWeaver 对细粒度的证据块进行操作，并将它们编织成详细的声明级别结构。如表所示Unlike WebWeaver, which summarizes evidence into coarse-grained outline titles at the webpage level, DeepWeaver operates on fine-grained evidence chunks and weaves them into detailed claim-level structures. 5 相关工作Related Work

检索增强和归因生成。Retrieval-Augmented and Attributed Generation.

检索增强生成是将外部知识纳入问答的常见方法Retrieval-augmented generation is a common way to incorporate external knowledge in question answering(11; 32; 50)。稀疏向量检索. Sparse vector retrieval(33; 42; 34)通过词频或关键词匹配检索相关文本，同时进行密集向量检索retrieves relevant text through term-frequency or keyword matching, while dense vector retrieval(22; 13; 27)将查询和文本编码为向量。 最近的进展通过自我反思检索控制、图形结构证据组织、交错检索和推理以及基于搜索的规划进一步改进了检索encodes the query and text into vectors. Recent advances further improve retrieval through self-reflective retrieval control, graph-structured evidence organization, interleaved retrieval and reasoning, and search-based planning(3; 12; 45; 15).

长上下文证据整合。Long-Context Evidence Integration.

更大的上下文窗口允许模型包含更多检索到的证据，但长上下文模型仍然可能忽略长输入或噪声输入中的相关信息Larger context windows allow models to include more retrieved evidence, but long-context models may still overlook relevant information in long or noisy inputs(26; 14; 29)。 一系列工作改进了将上游检索到的证据呈现给模型的方式。 上下文细化方法在生成之前压缩、过滤或重组检索到的段落，包括 RECOMP、Chain-of-Note 和 LongRefiner. A line of work improves how upstream retrieved evidence is presented to the model. Context-refinement methods compress, filter, or restructure retrieved passages before generation, including RECOMP, Chain-of-Note, and LongRefiner(48; 55; 21)。 分治法. Divide-and-conquer methods(57; 60; 9)将长上下文分割成更小的片段并聚合中间输出。这些方法通过使用更粗糙的证据表示来细化输入，从而减少上下文负担split long contexts into smaller segments and aggregate intermediate outputs. These methods reduce context burden by refining input with coarser evidence representations(19)，但留下了未充分探索的证据合成差距。, but leave the evidence synthesis gap underexplored.

长篇基础写作和深入研究代理。Long-Form Grounded Writing and Deep-Research Agents.

通过大纲引导写作和反思驱动生成来研究长篇扎根写作，主要用于调查生成Long-form grounded writing has been studied through outline-guided writing and reflection-driven generation, mainly for survey generation(51; 36; 35; 47)，但这些方法的主要目的并不是回答开放式问题。 以引文为导向的工作进一步提高了长篇答案的归属和可验证性, but these methods are not primarily designed to answer open-ended questions. Citation-oriented work further improves attribution and verifiability of long-form answers(16; 54)。 最近的深入研究代理将长格式写作扩展到端到端 QA 系统：其中一项工作重点是搜索计时和搜索推理交互. Recent deep-research agents extend long-form writing to end-to-end QA systems: one line of work focuses on search timing and search-reasoning interaction(23; 20)，另一个结合了证据收集和基于大纲的答案写作, another combines evidence collection with outline-based answer writing(24)等人通过代理监督微调和强化学习来提高代理能力, and others improve agent capabilities through agentic supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning(46; 59).

6 结论Conclusion

我们提出了 DeepWeaver，一个用于弥合开放式问答中证据合成差距的框架。 DeepWeaver 没有将检索到的证据视为扁平的长上下文输入，而是将嘈杂的证据组织到思想区块链 (TBC) 中，将细粒度的证据片段与基于证据的编织主张连接起来。通过迭代证据编织，DeepWeaver 识别被忽视的证据，完善不完整的主张，并改进细节保存和引文基础。我们还引入了 LoQA，这是一种用于评估基于证据的答案生成的高密度证据基准。知识库 QA 和基于网络的深度研究实验表明，DeepWeaver 持续提高多个 LLM 主干的答案质量。这些发现表明，有效的开放式质量保证需要检索和生成之间明确的证据合成机制，特别是在嘈杂和碎片化的证据下。We present DeepWeaver, a framework for bridging the evidence synthesis gap in open-ended question answering. Rather than treating retrieved evidence as a flat long-context input, DeepWeaver organizes noisy evidence into Thought Block Chains (TBCs), which connect fine-grained evidence fragments with evidence-grounded woven claims. Through iterative evidence weaving, DeepWeaver identifies overlooked evidence, refines incomplete claims, and improves detail preservation and citation grounding. We also introduce LoQA, a high-density evidence benchmark for evaluating evidence-grounded answer generation. Experiments on knowledge-base QA and web-based deep research show that DeepWeaver consistently improves answer quality across multiple LLM backbones. These findings suggest that effective open-ended QA requires explicit evidence synthesis mechanisms between retrieval and generation, especially under noisy and fragmented evidence.

7 局限性Limitations

在这项工作中，我们研究证据编织作为推进检索增强开放式问答的一种方式。虽然 DeepWeaver 提高了证据合成质量，但仍然存在一些局限性。首先，LoQA 关注中国的水环境问题。尽管该领域提供了密集的技术证据和复杂的实际问题，但它并没有涵盖所有语言、领域或文档类型。因此，我们在 DeepResearch Bench 上评估 DeepWeaver 作为补充设置，未来的工作将通过扩展其指标和评估协议来进一步丰富 LoQA。其次，DeepWeaver主要改进了证据收集后的证据合成阶段。在基于网络的设置中，我们重复使用 WebWeaver 规划器收集的网页和章节标题来隔离证据编织的影响。设计与 DeepWeaver 更好地结合的网络搜索代理仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。第三，DeepWeaver 目前专注于纯文本证据，而更完整的答案可能涉及图形、图表、图像或结构化数据。将证据编织扩展到多模式和结构化证据仍然是未来的工作。最后，虽然 DeepWeaver 改进了证据合成，但模型生成的内容仍然需要仔细验证。In this work, we study evidence weaving as a way to advance retrieval-augmented open-ended question answering. While DeepWeaver improves evidence synthesis quality, several limitations remain. First, LoQA focuses on Chinese water-environment questions. Although this domain provides dense technical evidence and complex practical problems, it does not cover all languages, domains, or document types. We therefore evaluate DeepWeaver on DeepResearch Bench as a complementary setting, and future work will further enrich LoQA by expanding its metrics and assessment protocols. Second, DeepWeaver mainly improves the evidence synthesis stage after evidence collection. In the web-based setting, we reuse web pages and section titles collected by WebWeaver’s planner to isolate the effect of evidence weaving. Designing web-search agents better aligned with DeepWeaver remains an open problem. Third, DeepWeaver currently focuses on text-only evidence, while more complete answers may involve figures, charts, images, or structured data. Extending evidence weaving to multimodal and structured evidence remains future work. Finally, although DeepWeaver improves evidence synthesis, model-generated content still requires careful verification.

A.1 LoQA 基准The LoQA Benchmark

A.1.1 数据统计Data Statistics

如表所示As shown in Table5，LoQA 包含 100 个问题，每个问题平均附有 206K 个证据标记和 91.79 个相关块。 对于评估，LoQA 包括 2,045 个原子评分点和 4,779 个完形填空空白，相当于平均每个问题 20.45 个评分点和 47.79 个空白。 每个问题的参考答案平均包含 9,858.64 个标记。 这些统计数据表明，LoQA 建立在广泛的噪声证据之上，旨在对证据合成质量进行压力测试，评估 QA 系统是否可以全面使用证据、保留细粒度的特定领域细节并生成被广泛引用的答案。, LoQA comprises 100 questions, each accompanied by an average of 206K evidence tokens and 91.79 relevant chunks. For evaluation, LoQA includes 2,045 atomic scoring points and 4,779 cloze blanks, corresponding to 20.45 scoring points and 47.79 blanks per question on average. The reference answers contain 9,858.64 tokens per question on average. These statistics indicate that LoQA is built on extensive noisy evidence and is designed to stress-test evidence synthesis quality, evaluating whether QA systems can comprehensively use evidence, preserve fine-grained domain-specific details, and generate well-cited answers.

A.1.2 施工细节Construction Details

图Figure4说明了LoQA的构建流程。 我们根据水环境领域的大型专家语料库构建了 LoQA。 我们从水利工程图书列表中约30,000本专业PDF书籍开始，首先筛选出4,484本具有相关标签的书籍，然后使用LLM根据书名、关键词和描述进一步识别与水生态、水环境和水循环相关的书籍。 这个过滤过程产生了800本相关书籍，我们从中随机选择500本作为知识库，并使用剩余的书籍作为实际问题生成的种子文档。 我们使用 PDF-Extract-Kit 从 PDF 中提取纯文本illustrates the construction pipeline of LoQA. We construct LoQA from a large-scale expert corpus in the water-environment domain. Starting from approximately 30,000 professional PDF books in our hydraulic engineering book list, we first select 4,484 books with relevant tags and then use an LLM to further identify books related to water ecology, water environment, and water circulation based on their titles, keywords, and descriptions. This filtering process yields 800 relevant books, from which we randomly select 500 as the knowledge base and use the remaining books as seed documents for practical question generation. We extract plain text from the PDFs using PDF-Extract-Kit(40; 58)，产生大约 360 MB 的干净文本。, resulting in approximately 360 MB of clean text.

问题生成和过滤。Question generation and filtering.

为了构建专业的开放式问题，我们从种子文档中随机抽取片段，并提示 GLM-4-Plus、DeepSeek-V3.2 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 生成具有不同风格和观点的问题。 每个模型为每个种子片段生成三个问题，总共产生 2,700 个候选问题。 我们要求问题脱离语境、简洁、一般可回答，并且依赖于多源领域知识。 然后，我们使用 DeepSeek-V3.2 从四个维度对每个问题进行评分：检索全面性、具体性、领域深度和表达完整性。 模糊、过于狭隘、扩展性不足或表达含糊的问题将被删除。 我们进一步选择与前 100 个检索到的块具有最高基于嵌入的余弦相似度的 100 个问题。 这些问题被保留作为最终的测试集。 （图To construct professional, open-ended questions, we randomly sample fragments from the seed documents and prompt GLM-4-Plus, DeepSeek-V3.2, and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 to generate questions with diverse styles and perspectives. Each model produces three questions for each seed fragment, yielding 2,700 candidate questions in total. We require the questions to be decontextualized, concise, generally answerable, and dependent on multi-source domain knowledge. We then use DeepSeek-V3.2 to score each question along four dimensions: retrieval comprehensiveness, concreteness, domain depth, and expression completeness. Questions that are vague, overly narrow, insufficiently extensible, or ambiguously expressed are removed. We further select the 100 questions with the highest embedding-based cosine similarity to their top-100 retrieved chunks. These questions are retained as the final test set. (Figure4 ②)

证据收集。Evidence collection.

我们将 500 本书的知识库分割成 1,024 个令牌片段，并使用 GLM-Embedding-3 对每个片段进行编码。 对于每个问题，我们检索大约 90-100 个与问题嵌入具有最高余弦相似度的片段：We segment the 500-book knowledge base into 1,024-token fragments and encode each fragment using GLM-Embedding-3. For each question, we retrieve approximately 90–100 fragments with the highest cosine similarity to the question embedding:

Erag=TopKei∈E⁡(⟨emb⁡(ei),emb⁡(q)⟩)E_{\mathrm{rag}}=\operatorname{TopK}_{e_{i}\in E}\left(\left\langle\operatorname{emb}(e_{i}),\operatorname{emb}(q)\right\rangle\right)

为了模拟真实的噪声检索，我们另外从语料库中采样了大约 100 个随机片段。 因此，每个问题都与 200 个证据片段配对，产生约 200K 个令牌的证据池。 （图To simulate realistic noisy retrieval, we additionally sample about 100 random fragments from the corpus. As a result, each question is paired with 200 evidence fragments, yielding an evidence pool of approximately 200K tokens. (Figure4③) 我们进一步使用 DeepSeek-V3.2 评估每个片段与问题的相关性，为引文基础评估提供注释。③) We further use DeepSeek-V3.2 to assess the relevance of each fragment to the question, providing annotations for citation-grounding evaluation.

评估准备。Evaluation preparation.

由于开放式专业问题通常不接受单一确定性的黄金答案，因此 LoQA 构建了根据特权证据输入合成的多个可能的参考答案。 对于每个问题，我们都会打乱相关证据片段Because open-ended professional questions typically do not admit a single deterministic gold answer, LoQA constructs multiple possible reference answers synthesized from privileged evidence inputs. For each question, we shuffle the relevant evidence fragmentsERE_{R}并将它们分成四个不相交的分区，以及完整的相关证据集：and split them into four disjoint partitions, together with the full relevant-evidence set:

ER0​-​25%,ER25​-​50%,ER50​-​75%,ER75​-​100%,ER0​-​100%E_{R}^{0\text{-}25\%},\ E_{R}^{25\text{-}50\%},\ E_{R}^{50\text{-}75\%},\ E_{R}^{75\text{-}100\%},\ E_{R}^{0\text{-}100\%}

DeepSeek-V3.2 从每个证据子集中生成一个参考答案，总共产生五个参考答案。 基于分区的答案促进了本地、细粒度的覆盖，同时在较低的上下文负担下生成，而完整证据的答案提供了全局综合。DeepSeek-V3.2 generates one reference answer from each evidence subset, yielding five reference answers in total. The partition-based answers promote local, fine-grained coverage while being generated under a lower context burden, whereas the full-evidence answer provides a global synthesis.

从这些参考答案中，我们构建了更多的评估目标。 首先，我们通过法学硕士从五个参考答案中提取原子论点。 这些论点捕获了关键的有证据支持的答案方面，并用于评估生成的答案是否涵盖了问题和证据暗示的主要内容。 其次，我们根据充分证据的参考答案构建完形填空式的空白。 这些空白主要针对特定​​领域的术语、概念和短语，用于评估生成的答案是否保留了细粒度的专业细节。 与证据相关性注释一起，这些目标使 LoQA 能够从三个维度评估答案：引文基础、内容充分性和细节保留。 （图From these reference answers, we construct more evaluation targets. First, we extract atomic arguments from the five reference answers via LLM. These arguments capture key evidence-supported answer aspects and are used to assess whether a generated answer covers the major content implied by the question and evidence. Second, we construct cloze-style blanks from the full-evidence reference answer. These blanks primarily target domain-specific terms, concepts, and short phrases, and are used to assess whether the generated answer preserves fine-grained professional details. Together with evidence relevance annotations, these targets enable LoQA to evaluate the answer along three dimensions: citation grounding, content sufficiency, and detail preservation. (Figure4 ④)

尽管LoQA使用DeepSeek-V3.2进行注释和验证，但它并不依赖于长篇答案的整体主观评分。 相反，我们将评估分解为短上下文提取和验证任务，包括证据相关性判断、原子论点匹配和完形填空恢复判断。 这些本地化决策比开放式偏好评分受到更多限制，并且属于最新高级法学硕士的可靠能力范围，使得 DeepSeek-V3.2 适合构建 LoQA 评估信号。Although LoQA uses DeepSeek-V3.2 for annotation and verification, it does not rely on holistic subjective scoring of long-form answers. Instead, we decompose evaluation into short-context extraction and verification tasks, including evidence relevance judgment, atomic argument matching, and cloze-blank recovery judgment. These localized decisions are substantially more constrained than open-ended preference scoring and fall within the reliable capability range of recent advanced LLMs, making DeepSeek-V3.2 suitable for constructing LoQA evaluation signals.

A.1.3 与之前的基准比较Comparison with Prior Benchmarks

表Table6将 LoQA 与长格式 QA、基于引文的生成、长上下文理解和深度研究代理的代表性基准进行了比较。 现有的基准主要强调解释性 QA、可验证的简短回答、长上下文理解或端到端网络研究。 相比之下，LoQA 旨在隔离证据利用阶段：每个专业的开放式问题都与固定、广泛且嘈杂的证据池配对，系统根据其生成直接解决问题的全面、引用良好且保留细节的答案的能力进行评估。 LoQA 是对先前基准的补充，适合研究开放式问答中的证据合成质量。compares LoQA with representative benchmarks for long-form QA, citation-grounded generation, long-context understanding, and deep-research agents. Existing benchmarks primarily emphasize explanatory QA, verifiable short-form answering, long-context comprehension, or end-to-end web research. In contrast, LoQA is designed to isolate the evidence-utilization stage: each professional open-ended question is paired with a fixed, extensive, and noisy evidence pool, and systems are evaluated by their ability to generate comprehensive, well-cited, and detail-preserving answers that directly address the question. LoQA is complementary to prior benchmarks and suitable for studying evidence synthesis quality in open-ended question answering.

A.2 将 DeepWeaver 扩展到 DeepResearch Bench 的详细信息Details of Extending DeepWeaver to DeepResearch Bench

DeepResearch Bench 主要评估端到端开放式深度研究 (OEDR) 系统，在该系统中，代理搜索网络、收集证据并生成开放式长格式答案。 由于 DeepWeaver 不包含搜索模块，因此我们研究了一个受控设置：给定相同的搜索系统和可比较的推理成本，DeepWeaver 是否可以改进证据到答案的生成阶段。DeepResearch Bench primarily evaluates end-to-end Open-Ended Deep-Research (OEDR) systems, in which agents search the web, collect evidence, and generate open-ended long-form answers. Because DeepWeaver does not include a search module, we study a controlled setting: given the same search system and comparable inference cost, whether DeepWeaver can improve the evidence-to-answer generation stage.

为此，我们使用WebWeaver的规划器To this end, we use the planner of WebWeaver(24)作为搜索者。 WebWeaver 是一个先进的双代理深度研究框架，其中规划器迭代搜索网页，细化分层的多级大纲，将网页分配给大纲节点，并从每个页面提取证据以构建记忆库。 然后作者根据收集到的证据填写大纲。 然而，在我们的设置中，DeepWeaver 并不依赖于 WebWeaver 的详细轮廓或提取的证据记忆。 我们只使用一级大纲标题as the searcher. WebWeaver is an advanced dual-agent deep-research framework, where the planner iteratively searches web pages, refines a hierarchical multi-level outline, assigns web pages to outline nodes, and extracts evidence from each page to build a memory bank. The writer then fills the outline based on the collected evidence. In our setting, however, DeepWeaver does not rely on WebWeaver’s detailed outline or extracted evidence memory. We only use the first-level outline titlesO1O_{1}以及相应的原始网页and the corresponding raw web pagesWW在每个标题下作为 DeepWeaver 的输入。 这使搜索层保持固定，同时允许我们隔离证据编织的影响 长格式答案生成。under each title as the input to DeepWeaver. This keeps the search layer fixed while allowing us to isolate the effect of evidence weaving during long-form answer generation.

对于每个一级大纲节点For each first-level outline nodeo∈O1o\in O_{1}，我们首先重写, we first rewriteoo进入节级 DeepWeaver 任务into a section-level DeepWeaver taskqq。 该模型还判断（路由）该部分是否对于回答原始问题至关重要或包含大量网页信息。 如果是这样，我们运行 DeepWeaver 来生成该部分；否则，我们使用直接生成。 这个重写和路由步骤仅消耗几百个令牌，并且成本可以忽略不计。 为了证据构建，我们截断了与以下内容相关的原始网页内容：. The model also judges (routes) whether the section is critical to answering the original question or contains extensive webpage information. If so, we run DeepWeaver to generate the section; otherwise, we use direct generation. This rewriting and routing step only consumes a few hundred tokens and has negligible cost. For evidence construction, we truncate the raw webpage content associated withoo最多 35K 个 token，并将其分割成 1,024 个 token 的片段，然后将其视为 DeepWeaver 的证据池。to at most 35K tokens and split it into 1,024-token fragments, which are then regarded as the evidence pool for DeepWeaver.

DeepWeaver 生成分段级答案后，我们应用轻量级的抛光阶段来提高流畅性和可读性。 然后，我们添加介绍和结论以生成完整的端到端答案。 这些完善、介绍和结论阶段是辅助组件，仅为了匹配 DeepResearch Bench 所需的答案格式而引入。核心比较重点在于 DeepWeaver 能否更有效地将网络证据合成为全面、有洞察力且被广泛引用的答案内容。After DeepWeaver generates the section-level answers, we apply a lightweight polishing stage to improve fluency and readability. We then add an introduction and a conclusion to produce a complete end-to-end answer. These polishing, introduction, and conclusion stages are auxiliary components introduced solely to match the answer format required by DeepResearch Bench. The core comparison focuses on whether DeepWeaver can more effectively synthesize web evidence into comprehensive, insightful, and well-cited answer content.

A.3 成本分析Cost Analysis

我们通过重用WebWeaver的Searcher（Planner）并用DeepWeaver替换下游writer来分析DeepResearch Bench上DeepWeaver的成本。为了减少 API 提供商、网络延迟和网页可访问性引入的差异，我们排除了网络搜索和页面访问的成本和运行时间，并仅测量 LLM 端计算。本地运行时间是使用本地 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 服务测量的We analyze the cost of DeepWeaver on DeepResearch Bench by reusing WebWeaver’s Searcher (Planner) and replacing the downstream writer with DeepWeaver. To reduce variance introduced by API providers, network latency, and webpage accessibility, we exclude the cost and runtime of web search and page access, and measure only LLM-side computation. Local runtime is measured with Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 services on local2×2\timesA100 GPU。A100 GPUs.

如表所示As shown in Table8，DeepWeaver 产生的货币成本与 WebWeaver 相当（0.313 美元 vs. 0.303 美元），同时将本地推理时间从 18.5 分钟减少到 14.2 分钟。尽管 DeepWeaver 消耗更多的输入令牌（3.16M vs. 2.35M），但它通过避免显式的网页级证据提取和内存库构建，将输出令牌从 307K 大幅减少到 94K。这种免提取的设计将预算从生成中间摘要重新分配到阅读更多原始证据。, DeepWeaver incurs a monetary cost comparable to WebWeaver ($0.313 vs. $0.303), while reducing local inference time from 18.5 to 14.2 minutes. Although DeepWeaver consumes more input tokens (3.16M vs. 2.35M), it substantially reduces output tokens from 307K to 94K by avoiding explicit webpage-level evidence extraction and memory-bank construction. This extraction-free design reallocates the budget from generating intermediate summaries to reading more original evidence.

在可比较的成本下，与 WebWeaver 中的 24K 令牌相比，DeepWeaver 可以将每个网页最多 35K 令牌的原始内容传递给作者，从而将每个观察到的令牌的成本降低Under comparable cost, DeepWeaver can pass up to 35K tokens of original content per webpage to the writer, compared with 24K tokens in WebWeaver, reducing the cost per observed token from1.26×10−51.26\times 10^{-5} to 8.94×10−68.94\times 10^{-6}。图. Figure6进一步表明 DeepWeaver 仅引入了轻量级的内部开销。主要的额外成本来自于further shows that DeepWeaver introduces only lightweight internal overhead. The main additional cost comes from the下属Subordinate阶段，检查残留证据并丰富TBC。然而，它的输出令牌使用率仅略高于stage, which inspects residual evidence and enriches the TBC. However, its output-token usage is only slightly higher than that of the吃水Draft和and总结Summary阶段，其总代币使用量仍与stages, and its total token usage remains comparable to the吃水Draft阶段。其他维护阶段，包括stage. Other maintenance stages, including提交Commit, 丢弃Discard, 波兰语Polish, 简介Intro, 和, and尾奏Outro，仅占总成本的一小部分。总体而言，DeepWeaver 提高证据利用率不是通过大幅增加成本，而是通过重新分配相同的预算：它避免了昂贵的中间输出生成和显式证据提取，而是使用轻量级 TBC 元数据将更多原始证据路由到集中答案生成中。, account for only a small fraction of the total cost. Overall, DeepWeaver improves evidence utilization not by substantially increasing cost, but by reallocating the same budget: it avoids expensive intermediate output generation and explicit evidence extraction, and instead uses lightweight TBC metadata to route more original evidence into focused answer generation.

A.5 案例研究Case Study

我们举两个例子来说明 DeepWeaver 如何通过在细化步骤中编织相关的思维块来构成新的主张。We present two examples to illustrate how DeepWeaver composes new claims by weaving related thought blocks across refinement steps.

质量保证LoQA

问题是，工业水处理从“污染治理”转向“资源回收”，如何重新定义？最初的主张分别讨论了水的再利用、能源回收、材料回收、生态评估和经济可行性。 DeepWeaver 将这些主张与有关循环资源利用和多维评估的从属主张联系起来。最终结果将废水处理重新构建为资源回收系统：废水不再仅仅被视为需要去除的污染物，而是作为回收水、能源和有价值材料的资源库。这个案例显示了DeepWeaver将分散的技术点转化为更高层次的概念主张的能力。The question is how industrial water treatment should be redefined when shifting from “pollution control” to “resource recovery.” The initial claims discuss water reuse, energy recovery, material recovery, ecological evaluation, and economic feasibility separately. DeepWeaver links these claims with subordinate claims about circular resource use and multidimensional evaluation. The final result reframes wastewater treatment as a resource recovery system: wastewater is no longer treated only as pollution to remove, but as a resource pool for recovering water, energy, and valuable materials. This case shows DeepWeaver’s ability to turn scattered technical points into a higher-level conceptual claim.

深度研究台DeepResearch Bench

课题是关于多模态数据融合驱动的运动智能辅导系统的应用和功能能力。索赔草案涵盖实时姿势矫正、表现评估、个性化训练、伤病预测和战术分析。 DeepWeaver进一步将这些功能与信号级、特征级和决策级融合连接起来。例如，姿势矫正被细化为融合 IMU 和视频数据以构建 3D 运动模型以实现即时反馈的主张；性能评估被细化为生物力学和生理信号的特征级融合。此案例展示了 DeepWeaver 如何将单独的应用程序声明转换为一组连贯的系统功能。The topic is about the applications and functional capabilities of a sports intelligent tutoring system driven by multimodal data fusion. The draft claims cover real-time posture correction, performance evaluation, personalized training, injury prediction, and tactical analysis. DeepWeaver further connects these functions with signal-level, feature-level, and decision-level fusion. For example, posture correction is refined into a claim about fusing IMU and video data to build a 3D motion model for immediate feedback; performance evaluation is refined into feature-level fusion of biomechanical and physiological signals. This case shows how DeepWeaver converts separate application claims into a coherent set of system capabilities.
